prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Asset: ONE transparent native 2D fighting-game idle animation spritesheet. Image1 is the accepted character design master; Image2 is the official PRIMARY GAME appearance reference. Preserve precisely the same character, anatomy, equipment and colors from Image1. Make exactly SIX separately drawn frames of a calm breathing guard cycle in a 3-column by 2-row grid on a1536x1024 canvas: six512x512 cells, reading left-to-right then top-to-bottom. No visible grid or labels.
CRITICAL full-body framing: each character must be NO MORE THAN370px tall inside its cell, head roughlyy80, solesy450. At least48px of truly empty transparent space on ALL cell edges, including feet and longest equipment. Put each body at x256 with the same scale and planted foot locations throughout. Never crop fingers, toes, dreads or shoulder cannon. Six DISTINCT poses: subtle chest inhalation then exhalation, knee settling, elbow adjustment, small coherent hand motion and dreadlock follow-through, returning to start. No walking, jumps, attacks or costume changes.
Use clear lateral three-quarter combat orientation, opponent at the named screen side. Draw natural anatomy: exactly two arms, two legs and coherent five-digit clawed hands with thumbs, no fused palms. Correct fixed anatomical equipment sides: LEFT shoulder single plasma caster and larger layered pauldron, LEFT forearm red-display wrist computer, RIGHT forearm strapped housing with only TWO SHORT RETRACTED blade tips. Empty hands, no held gun/sword or new prop. This is an authored orientation, NEVER a horizontal mirror of the master. Armor and weapon sides remain anatomically correct when the body rotates.
Detailed painted game sprite, neutral even lighting, readable silhouette. Six separate complete silhouettes with matching body size. Genuine transparent alpha background. No floor, shadow, halo, smoke, glow, text, watermarks, logos, backdrop, frame or extra reference thumbnail.
Identity: the UNMASKED ELDER CLASS of Predator: Hunting Grounds, with the same aged patterned gray/tan forehead, FOUR exterior mandibles, orange eyes, dark gray cuffed dreadlocks, diamond netting, patterned reddish leather bandolier and small skull/bead necklace from Image1. Left chest layered silver armor, right chest mostly netted. Preserve face—not a human, ogre or generic monster. Do not add a helmet.
ALL SIX FRAMES FACE SCREEN RIGHT. Head, shoulders and forward toes read clearly toward RIGHT, torso at about55degrees from camera. No frame looks straight at camera or opposite direction. Draw this actual view rather than flipping the other side. Front plane equipment may occlude the far wrist naturally; do not transplant it.
